note: Experiment 92's second brief: the value bar today's pipeline already has in writing, in plain words. It is the bar the triage step of kamp-us/phoenix's fabrika plugin states (claude-plugins/fabrika/skills/triage/SKILL.md, step 8), in force on demlik since before any test ticket was filed. Its two other clauses, superseded and duplicate of a parent, are already in the drafted bar, so only these are added to it. General rules written for every repo, not fitted to any ticket here; but triage applied them to the test tickets, so this brief is the one closest to the answer key.

no.rule: The only thing it would make is a record nobody then acts on: a decision written down for its own sake.
no.reason: won't do: a record nobody acts on

example.what: a ticket asking to write a decision down when nothing will change because of it

no.rule: An agent filed it against the project's own output, and it changes no behavior: renamed words, a tidied list, a docblock or sample nit, a doc sentence missing one clause of a check that already works.
no.reason: won't do: churn on our own output, no behavior change

example.what: a ticket to reword a docblock that is already correct in substance

no.rule: It hardens something that has never failed for a real user. Ask: has this ever failed in real use? If not, it is a no. A missing test for a check that already works is this; so is nice-to-have telemetry or cost reporting for a cost nobody pays.
no.reason: not now: hardening with no incident

example.what: a ticket adding a test for a refusal that already refuses

stillYes.rule: A ticket a person filed by hand (not an agent) is never closed by these rules alone; only a duplicate is folded. Agent-filed tickets end in a 'Filed by' footer.

example.what: a person's short report that fits a no rule goes on, for an owner to judge
